sql.proposalTemplate.findById: select pt.id, pt.template_name, coalesce((select row_to_json(theme) from (select t.id, t.theme_name as name, coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object('id', ptv1.id, 'key', ptv1.theme_key)) from brs.proposal_theme_value ptv1 where ptv1.proposal_theme_id = t.id), '[]') as "themeClasses", coalesce((select json_object_agg(ptv2.theme_key, ptv2.theme_value) from brs.proposal_theme_value ptv2 where ptv2.proposal_theme_id = t.id), '{}') as "themeStyle" from brs.proposal_theme t where t.id = pt.proposal_theme_id) theme), '{}') as theme, coalesce((select array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(blocks))) from (select ptb.id, ptb.proposal_theme_value_id as "themeKeyId", ptv.theme_key as "themeKey", ptbt.id as "blockTypeId", ptbt.block_type as "blockType", ptbk.id as "blockKindId", ptbk.block_kind as "blockKind", ptb.block_style as "blockStyle", ptb.block_value as "blockValue", ptb.block_order as "blockOrder", ptb.version, ptb.parent_id as "parentId" from brs.proposal_template_block ptb inner join brs.proposal_template_block_type ptbt on ptb.proposal_template_block_type_id = ptbt.id left join brs.proposal_theme_value ptv on ptb.proposal_theme_value_id = ptv.id left join brs.proposal_template_block_kind ptbk on ptb.proposal_template_block_kind_id = ptbk.id where ptb.proposal_template_id = pt.id) blocks), '[]') as blocks, pt.created_by_id, pt.date_created, pt.modified_by_id, pt.date_modified from brs.proposal_template pt where pt.id = :id
sql.proposalTemplate.findBlocksByIds: select ptb.id, ptb.proposal_theme_value_id as "themeKeyId", ptv.theme_key as "themeKey", ptbt.id as "blockTypeId", ptbt.block_type as "blockType", ptbk.id as "blockKindId", ptbk.block_kind as "blockKind", ptb.block_style as "blockStyle", ptb.block_value as "blockValue", ptb.block_order as "blockOrder", ptb.version, ptb.parent_id as "parentId" from brs.proposal_template_block ptb inner join brs.proposal_template_block_type ptbt on ptb.proposal_template_block_type_id = ptbt.id left join brs.proposal_theme_value ptv on ptb.proposal_theme_value_id = ptv.id left join brs.proposal_template_block_kind ptbk on ptb.proposal_template_block_kind_id = ptbk.id where ptb.id in (:ids)
sql.proposalTemplate.updateBlocks: update brs.proposal_template_block set proposal_theme_value_id = :themeValueId, proposal_template_block_type_id = :blockTypeId, proposal_template_block_kind_id = :blockKindId, block_style = :blockStyle, block_value = :blockValue, block_order = :blockOrder, parent_id = :parentId, version = version + 1, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id and proposal_template_id = :templateId and version = :version
sql.proposalTemplate.availableTags: SELECT a.attname::text AS tag FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a INNER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON a.attrelid = t.typrelid INNER jOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace where pg_catalog.format_type(t.oid, NULL) = 'brs.calculated_proposal_value' except SELECT a.attname::text AS tag FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a INNER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON a.attrelid = t.typrelid INNER jOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace where pg_catalog.format_type(t.oid, NULL) = 'brs.excluded_proposal_value' order by 1;
